examples.english: The young man works in the same office.

examples.arabic: هو شاب طيب جدا ويحب مساعدة الاسرة
examples.english: He is a very kind young man and loves to help the family.
examples.transliteration: Huwa shabbun tayyibun jiddan wa yuhibbu musa'adata al-usra.

examples.arabic: الموظف الشاب قال ان سياسات الارجاع تغيرت مع الوقت
examples.english: The young employee said that return policies have changed with time.
examples.transliteration: Al-muwazzafu ash-shaabu qaala inna siyaasaati al-irjaa'i taghayyarat ma'a al-waqti.
examples.storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

examples.arabic: ارشدني شاب ودود الى عبور مفترق الطرق عند اشارة المرور ومن ثم الانعطاف يمينا عند الدوار الكبير حيث يقع مبنى المكتبة
examples.english: A friendly young man guided me to cross the intersection at the traffic light and then turn right at the large roundabout where the library building is located.
examples.transliteration: Arshadani shabbun wadudun ila 'uburi muftaraqi al-turuqi 'inda isharati al-mururi wa min thamma al-in'itafi yaminan 'inda al-duwwari al-kabiri haythu yaqa'u mabna al-maktabati.
